dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description: The name of the field to which these settings apply

colorMapping.description: The color mapping to use if field values map to different colors.  Prioritize colorMapping before color.

donutType.description:
Node donuts can be of type 'segment' and 'percentage'.
If 'percentage' is specified, a single donut sized by the average of the value specified at
{@link #fieldName} is set. The color of the donut has be set at {@link #color}.

If 'segment' is specified, multiple donut segments sized by the count of the unique values
specified at {@link #fieldName} are set. The color of the donut segment pertaining to each unique
categorical value at {@link #fieldName} has be set at {@link #colorMap}.

title:
The configuration to set a donut around a clustered node based on the aggregration of the specified
property in the constituent nodes.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationNodeClusterDonutConfig
